requirements.name: A notification carries one country of origin, mandatory regardless of how many commodity lines it holds

scenarios.name: A single origin answer covers every commodity line

tests.test: a country picked from the type-ahead is saved and shown again on return
tests.notes: one notification-level origin answer on a multi-step potato journey; not asked per line

tests.test: the narrowing is enforced at Continue, so a saved country is refused once a ware-potato line joins it
tests.notes: same origin answer still held after a second commodity line is added

requirements.name: The countries a notification may name narrow to the strictest scope any of its commodity lines carries

scenarios.name: A seed-potato consignment may name any country in the origin block

tests.test: a seed-potato consignment may name any country in the origin block
tests.notes: Norway accepted; also asserts no narrowing guidance is shown

requirements.name: Each non-seed commodity category carries a fixed origin country scope

scenarios.name: A ware-potato consignment is narrowed to Poland, Portugal, Romania or Spain

tests.test: a ware-potato consignment is narrowed to Poland, Portugal, Romania or Spain
shows the ware-potato scope guidance and refuses a country outside the four
accepts one of the four ware-potato countries

scenarios.name: A conifer-wood-without-bark line is narrowed to Italy, France, Portugal or Spain

tests.test: a conifer-wood-without-bark line is narrowed to Italy, France, Portugal or Spain
tests.notes: Germany rejected (proving the scope is narrower than EU membership), Italy accepted

scenarios.name: A plants-for-planting line is narrowed to the EU member States

tests.test: a plants-for-planting line is narrowed to the EU member States
refuses a country outside the EU for a wood consignment
tests.notes: confirms the same EU-member-state scope applies to a wood category, not only plants-for-planting

requirements.name: Adding a more restrictive commodity line re-validates an already-saved country

scenarios.name: A saved country is refused once a stricter commodity line joins it

tests.test: the narrowing is enforced at Continue, so a saved country is refused once a ware-potato line joins it
tests.notes: France saved under seed-potatoes-only, then a ware-potato line is added; re-saving origin without changing the country is refused
